notes.title: Steam Couch Coop Fest
notes.content:
Sclash is part of Couch Coop Fest! 

If you didn't try Sclash already, you're more than welcome to join our wonderful community ♥

Sclash is a plug’n play 2D samurai fighting game full of tension where one hit is enough to kill. Play as a hand-drawn samurai in beautiful painted settings and fight your opponent in epic solemn duels where each move matters. Manage well your stamina, breath and take your time to land a deadly hit.

We love gathering friends, and what is better than a fighting game to spend some good time together! :D

notes.title: 1.1.56 - Rebinds & lots of fixes
notes.content:
The awaited "next update" is here with rebind functionality & more! Have a look

CHANGES & ADDITIONS
- REBINDS
- Halved the chances of weather effects in the relevant stages
- Added an option to disable weather effects
- Added a notification sound when someone joins an online room
- Set the thunder in Chapter 5 and Night Battlefield to be in the FX audio group so that the audio settings actually affect them
- Added an option to turn off the camera shake

BALANCING
- Sped up Izanagi perfect parry anim
- Increased Izanagi's charged attack range
- Buffed Izanagi's attacks frame data
- Buffed Susanoo's kick range
- Adjusted how the pommel strike hitbox is calculated
- Increased a bit Izanagi's pommel range
- Increased a very tiny tad Masked Ronin's pommel range

BUG FIXES
- Fixed the fact that no matter what only the bridge would load on startup
- Fixed a sync issue for the stages in online mode
- Fixed missing characters in Japanese text and changed its font weight for better readability
- Fixed the display of different languages in the Story mode menu
- Made perfect parry achievement a bit easier to get
- Fixed scarf & hair staying on stage in online mode
- Disabled some cheats in online mode
- Fixed a typo in "Fox Katana"
- Fixed "Platinum" achievement not triggering
- Fixed settings menu not responding in Chapter 4
- Fixed MaskedRonin story attack frame data
- Fixed Izanagi attack animation active frame data
- Made "Complete fighter" achievement slightly easier to get, player can fail to meet one action requirement and still get it
- Fixed the garden environment not loading in Chapter 4
- Updated  some missing localized texts
- Fixed story Masked Ronin getting stuck in knocked-back animation

notes.title: Next update
notes.content:
Hey guys,
We thought it's been a while we hadn't posted anything on here.
So just letting you know, the next update is almost complete, there's just one nasty bug in there and then we'll release it.

[h3]Briefly, it will include among other things :[/h3]
- REBINDS, FUCKING REBINDS (This is where there's one last bug)
- A bit of balancing
- More accessibility options
- Some achievements & seasonal events were not triggering correctly so we fixed those
- Random stage on online lobby creation
- Made weather effects togglable and less frequent
- Sound when a player joins a room
- Disabled cheats online for those who might have tried using them
- Fixed stage selection settings
- Removed the annoying scarf online
- General polish & bug fixes

I promise we're doing what we can to fix this last thing. (Basically rebinds only work if you restart the game, so I guess in the worst-case scenario we can just release it like that...)

Once that's done GOG and itch.io will have the online mode arriving soon
Thanks for your support, stay tuned

- Increased a bit the startup of Jinmu's pommel strike

notes.title: 1.1.44 balancing update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, before bug fixes for the online mode and an upcoming tournament we wanted to update a bit of the game's balancing after the community's feedback and our feelings about the characters.

IZANAGI
- Increased attack range a bit
- Increased parry recovery speed
- Made stomp anim faster
- Increased a bit stomp range
- Sped up a bit Perfect Parry anim

SUSANOO
- Increased a bit invulnerability duration on dashes. i-frames also start earlier now
- Sped up a bit kick anim startup
- Sped up a bit attack animations

JINMU
- Removed i-frames on his neutral attack
- Reduced a bit light attack range

MASKED RONIN
- Increased a bit pommel strike range

OTHER STUFF
- Changed parry stamina recovery to be 3 bars instead of 2
- Changed stamina break to be 1 bar instead of 2

Hopefully, these will make the game feel more balanced and all options worth it. Let us know your thoughts when playing this new version, thanks !

We’re taking part in the War Child UK Armistice Sale!  
Starting today (7 pm CET/10 am PT) and until November 15th, we’ll donate a portion of every sale of Sclash. to War Child UK. Make sure to grab your discounted copy, gift one to a friend, or let them know about the sale. 
This year’s Armistice Sale is celebrating peaceful play and highlighting the importance of protecting, educating, and standing up for the rights of children living in war zones. War Child work in the hardest-to-reach places to support those who are hardest hit, to protect, educate, and stand up for the rights of children, when they need them most.

notes.title: Online Mode - Public Test Live!
notes.content:
It's finally time.
After all the waiting.
The online mode is just one step ahead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37554654/3e182ec380ecf6fa2084b5249f35012fcac3c44a.png[/img]

[h2]One full week of public access to the online mode for testing purposes.[/h2]
We're launching the online mode for an entire week (as well as a small discount to help you get into the game easily ! ;-)). That will enable us to see if our previous close playtests and fix worked well and where we can still improve. 

Try to connect between 6 to 10pm CEST to maximize your chance to find another player. Use the invite code system to play against a friend!


Console ports are also at an advanced stage and next weeks will be crucial to implement the latest online changes to them. We're aiming to release the full online mode and console versions in a few weeks if everything goes as smooth as we can hope.

Should we plan a tournament around the online launch?


Have fun and don't hesitate to report problems either through the form in-game or on our [url=https://discord.gg/ebTZPx4Pns]Discord server[/url].

Thank you a lot for your support again!
Bevel Bakery & Just For Games

notes.title: 1.1.1 - "Save file erased" bug fixed ! And other stuff
notes.content:
[h2]SAVE FILE CORRUPTED BUG :[/h2]
[b]- Fixed! [/b]The game was not recognizing Chapter 5 save files because of some last-minute changes. The good news is that the save file is not deleted, unless you overwrote it by starting a new game you should be able to continue your playthrough normally.

[h2]OTHER STUFF :[/h2]
- Enforced 16:9 aspect ratio for wide screens
- Set Akiko to not be here in Zen mode in Chapter 5
- Adjusted firewall distance for Ryuujin checkpoint in Chapter 4
- Changed the speed of the Firewall visuals
- Unlocked story achievements that did not trigger for some people, now if you completed the story mode you should have them.
- Updated credits to put some names that were missing from them
- Fixed active frames of Masked Ronin
- Added text indicator below the modes' names in the story menu to tell the player they will overwrite their current save file if they have one.

[b]Thanks, everyone, for reporting bugs![/b]

notes.title: Online ETA & playtests
notes.content:
Hello everyone, some news concerning the online mode you've all been awaiting.

[h3]First, we're sorry we couldn't make it happen for the release of the game, we know many expressed their disappointment (Rightfully so) because it was not here. [/h3]

We are a small team of 3 independent developers and this is our first game, we lack some experience and knowledge. Sadly even if the online mode works, it wasn't ready for the release, a release date we could not postpone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37554654/b12d26613f506ea2a98500204fbe453cd56f5df6.png[/img]

We can now give you an estimated window of the release for the online mode, which will most likely come with the rebind options.

[h2]Mid / End of September[/h2]

[h3][b]We will be running playtests of the online mode before the end of the month most likely, and you can participate. [u][url=https://discord.gg/ebTZPx4Pns]Join our Discord server to register for playtesting[/url][/u]. Not everyone will be selected, we apologize in advance.[/b][/h3]

Thank you very much, everyone, for your support, we hope to make the game as great as possible and answer all of your feedback.

[i]PS: We are aware of all the bugs including game breaking ones you've reported, we're on it as well, sorry for the inconvenience.[/i]

notes.title: Sclash releases today
notes.content:
Hey everyone.

We can't believe this, finally, the game will be released. The culmination of 4 years of hard work, of struggle. We hope you'll like it and won't be too harsh on it if there are bugs.

We apologize the online mode won't be available right at the release, we need a little more time to polish it, but in the meantime, you can always hop on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/ZQW7bKv][u][b]Discord server[/b][/u][/url] to find people to play with through Parsec or Steam Remote Play.

[h2]We need your help[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37554654/d71c6e88d72697caa20f44255ba41957cfef9fe1.png[/img]

We don't have a lot of communication power, so if you could help us relay the release it would be awesome. Share our posts, tell your friends about it.

[h3]And most importantly, please leave a positive evaluation to the game as soon as possible if you didn't hate it.[/h3]

It would help us so much, thank you in advance. Of course, don't forget to add it to your wishlist and invite your friends to do so as well!

Thank you very much, everyone, we hope the game will live up to your expectations.
Have a good one.

notes.title: Demo 3.8.8
notes.content:
Hey everyone, new demo update with a few changes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37554654/9d411fed2ec96b3cb6bead4bd4af2e65cc92b1a8.png[/img]

[h3]3.8.8 here we go baby:[/h3]

[b]Bug fixes & various stuff:[/b]
- Capped FPS to 60.
- Disabled double tap dash for now.
- Fixed some minor UI tidbits.
- Fixed score names displayed on the win screen, which was only in English before, now works for all languages.
- Minor fix of language & accessibility settings title display.
- Amaterasu's second swing on his double swing attacks no longer has a hitbox on the back of the character, only the first swing during a forward attack.
- Adjusted slow-mo & camera shake.
- Various minor fixes & polish

[b]Balancing:[/b]
- Increased a little Amaterasu's attacks recovery duration.

[b]Improvements & features:[/b]
- Added slow-mo and feedback to pommel strike stamina break.

The FPS is now capped at 60 so don't hesitate to tell us if you notice any performance improvement or less GPU usage, would really help us!
The next update should see some performance improvements, we have a lead.

Thank you, everyone, that will be all!

notes.title: Stunfest was awesome!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37554654/3516ef34b3744fc962bad93cd6f7a79a55a5fed1.png[/img]

This weekend we were at the Stunfest in Rennes, the biggest fighting games & indie games festival in France, and it was amazing!

We had a big booth with 2 sofas and big screens thanks to our publisher [url=https://www.justforgames.com/][i][u][b]Just For Games[/b][/u][/i][/url], and so many people came to play Sclash, thank you very much to all those who came to see us and play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37554654/e0653a3be8d5f164f43023c60a4f34b7b74243eb.jpg[/img]

We also met tons of cool people and other developers, and organized a tournament with our publisher and the Stunfest, with a trophy, medals and games to win!

Congratulations to Pox for reaching first place, Barbu for 2nd place, and Nimai for 3rd place, and congratulations to all other participants of course!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37554654/d0bfa29e9b1f24a7bbc4fdff08be5f292ca4b769.jpg[/img]

Our publishing partner Abiding Bridge this year again won 2 awards among the 4 (Last year we won the public choice award) so it was really fulfilling 

Thanks again to all the teams of the Stunfest and all our partners who made this event possible as is.

notes.title: Sclash
notes.content:
Sclash is a plug’n play samurai fighting game full of tension where one hit means death.

Play as an experimented samurai with easy to execute actions for everyone. Breath and take time to anticipate your next moves and your enemy’s ones in large maps.
Manage well your stamina to land a deadly hit to your opponent and win the round.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37554654/8e2503a027aad38abca6bdf7b9dff632cdee115b.png[/img]

We are a team of 3 developers and a compositor working on Sclash since one year!
What began as a student project became an actual game we will be releasing before the end of 2020!

The demo features one of the 4 characters who will be playable in the final release, on one of the stages, the most important one!
Just click the play button or the title to directly choose your character, then draw and start the fight in a blink!

The game works with a controller or the keyboard, with very easy actions allowing everyone to play it, with no loading time, fights start and are understood very quickly, and are very cool !

You can enable the AI opponent with up / down inputs during the character selection

You also have detailed stats of your fights, in case you're curious about them!



If you're curious about the development, want to participate in it, talk with the devs, and maybe have access to beta versions, you can follow us on social networks and join our Discord community!
Twitter : https://twitter.com/SclashTheGame
Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/sclashthegame/
